title: Code Generation by Differential Test Time Scaling
authors_zh: Yifeng He、Ethan Wang、Jicheng Wang、Xuanxin Ouyang、Hao Chen（机构：加州大学戴维斯分校、武汉大学、香港大学）
paper_type_zh: 高效代码生成测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 没有公开测试用例、却需要以可执行分析替代奖励模型重排序的代码助手开发者。
one_line: DiffCodeGen uses coverage-guided differential testing to select among diverse code candidates with almost no extra LLM-token cost beyond candidate generation.
DiffCodeGen 利用覆盖引导的差分测试从多样代码候选中选择结果，除候选生成外几乎不增加大语言模型词元成本。
why: It turns the behavioral agreement of independently generated programs into an inexpensive verifier and shifts test-time budget from model calls to executable analysis.
inclusion_reason: It allocates test-time compute to diverse code sampling and program execution, replacing extra LLM verification calls with coverage-guided behavioral selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Sampling makes code generation more likely to contain a correct program, but a real assistant must return one program rather than an oracle pass@k score. Existing test-time methods often use public tests or ask an LLM to generate and judge additional test cases. Public tests are usually absent for a new function, while extra model calls consume time and tokens and can make selection as expensive as generating the candidates themselves.

The paper asks how to select a good program from several sampled implementations when no trusted test suite exists. The desired selector must use the computation already available in a programming environment, distinguish implementations by their observable behavior, and avoid treating a model-generated verdict as a reliable oracle. It should improve pass@1 while keeping the marginal cost of selection far below that of an additional reasoning or verification rollout.

采样会提高代码生成中存在正确程序的概率，但真实助手必须返回一个程序，而不是预言式的 pass@k 分数。既有测试时方法常使用公开测试，或要求大语言模型生成并判断额外测试案例。新函数通常没有公开测试；而额外模型调用会消耗时间和词元，使选择成本接近生成候选本身。

论文研究在没有可信测试套件时，如何从多个采样实现中选出好程序。理想选择器必须使用编程环境中已经可用的计算，通过可观察行为区分实现，并避免把模型生成的判断视为可靠预言机。它应改善 pass@1，同时让选择的边际成本远低于一次额外推理或验证 rollout。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DiffCodeGen treats independently generated programs as multiple implementations of the same natural-language specification. Differential testing supplies a pseudo-oracle: if most candidates agree on outputs for diverse valid inputs while one differs, the outlier is more likely to contain a bug. This does not need an expected output for every fuzzed input, only the assumption that correct implementations should behave consistently under the same specification.

The method first creates diverse candidates, then uses coverage-guided fuzzing to find inputs that exercise meaningful code paths. It executes every candidate on those inputs, represents each program by its observed behavior, clusters the candidates, and returns the medoid of the largest behavior cluster. The central allocation decision is to spend inference budget on multiple first-pass candidates and executable analysis, not on a second LLM-based selector.

DiffCodeGen 把独立生成的程序视为同一自然语言规格的多个实现。差分测试提供伪预言机：若多数候选在多样有效输入上输出一致、而一个候选不同，离群者更可能含有错误。它不需要知道每个模糊输入的期望输出，只需假设正确实现应在相同规格下行为一致。

方法先产生多样候选，再用覆盖引导模糊测试寻找能触发有意义代码路径的输入。它在这些输入上执行每个候选，用观察到的行为表示程序，对候选聚类，并返回最大行为簇的中心候选。核心分配决定是把推理预算花在多个首次候选和可执行分析上，而不是花在第二个基于大语言模型的选择器上。

title: Method
方法
html:
The differential-generation stage uses three ways to create candidate diversity: repeated stochastic sampling at temperature 0.7 and nucleus probability 0.95, beam search, and eighteen semantic-preserving prompt perturbations. For each collection, the method chooses a reference candidate, instruments it, and fuzzes it to obtain inputs. Script programs use AFL++ or py-afl; library functions use libFuzzer or Atheris, with a single LLM-generated fuzz driver only when necessary.

All candidates execute on the fuzzed inputs. Their outputs define behavior distances, which are clustered into two groups; the candidate with the smallest relative distance to peers in the largest group is selected. The paper evaluates four code models on LiveCodeBench, compares with test-free baselines, and measures pass@1 together with wall-clock time and token use. This separates the cost of generating alternatives from the much smaller selection cost that uses program execution rather than further model inference.

差分生成阶段使用三种方式制造候选多样性：温度 0.7、nucleus 概率 0.95 的重复随机采样，束搜索，以及十八种保持语义的提示扰动。对每个候选集合，方法选取一个参考候选，对其插桩并模糊测试以获得输入。脚本程序使用 AFL++ 或 py-afl；库函数使用 libFuzzer 或 Atheris，只有必要时才用一次大语言模型调用生成模糊驱动器。

所有候选都在模糊输入上执行。输出定义行为距离，随后被聚成两组；最大组中与同伴相对距离最小的候选被选中。论文在 LiveCodeBench 上评测四个代码模型，与无需测试的基线比较，并测量 pass@1、墙钟时间和词元使用。这把生成替代方案的成本与更小的选择成本区分开来，后者使用程序执行而非进一步模型推理。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported experiments show consistent gains over the compared test-free baselines across four language models. The paper emphasizes that the method selects among candidates without an additional LLM selection pass. On LiveCodeBench with locally served models, its execution time is about one fifth of earlier test-time methods; for API-based models it uses roughly five percent of their time, and it consumes around four percent of the input tokens used by those methods. These comparisons support an efficiency claim, not merely a pass@k opportunity claim.

The evidence also identifies why coverage matters. Random inputs can repeatedly exercise common paths and fail to expose semantic disagreement, whereas coverage-guided inputs search less common branches before candidates are clustered. The method can be combined with reasoning models and other test-time procedures because its selection stage is model agnostic. Its pass@1 result remains the appropriate deployment metric: the final program is selected without access to the benchmark's hidden tests.

报告的实验显示，在四个语言模型上，该方法相对比较的无需测试基线都有稳定收益。论文强调它在选择候选时不需要额外的大语言模型选择调用。在 LiveCodeBench 上，对本地部署模型，它的执行时间约为先前测试时方法的五分之一；对 API 模型，它约使用这些方法百分之五的时间，并消耗约百分之四的输入词元。这些比较支持的是效率主张，而不只是 pass@k 式的机会主张。

证据还说明为何覆盖率重要。随机输入可能反复触发常见路径，无法暴露语义分歧；而覆盖引导输入会在聚类前探索较少见分支。该方法可与推理模型及其他测试时程序组合，因为其选择阶段与模型无关。pass@1 仍是合适的部署指标：最终程序在不知道基准隐藏测试的情况下被选出。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not simply to fuzz LLM-generated code. It makes differential agreement among multiple sampled programs the selection signal for test-time scaling, and joins it with coverage guidance so that candidate disagreement is sought in informative execution regions. This replaces a common second model pass with an executable behavioral test, retaining the benefits of diversity while avoiding a dependence on public unit tests.

The method also distinguishes candidate generation from candidate verification. Sampling, beam search, and prompt variation deliberately create alternative implementations; the clustering stage exploits their agreement without assuming any one candidate is a gold reference. It does not prove that the majority behavior is correct when all candidates share the same misconception, but it creates a concrete non-neural consumer for parallel code samples and therefore changes the accuracy-cost curve at inference.

贡献不只是对大语言模型生成代码进行模糊测试。它把多个采样程序间的差分一致性作为测试时扩展的选择信号，并将其与覆盖引导结合，使候选分歧在信息量高的执行区域被寻找。这以可执行行为测试替代常见的第二次模型调用，在不依赖公开单元测试的同时保留多样性收益。

方法还区分候选生成与候选验证。采样、束搜索和提示变体刻意产生替代实现；聚类阶段利用它们的一致性，却不假定任何一个候选是金标准。它不能证明当所有候选共享同一误解时多数行为一定正确，但它为并行代码样本创造了具体的非神经消费者，因此改变了推理时的准确率—成本曲线。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Behavioral consensus can be wrong when many candidates reproduce the same specification error, and fuzzing can miss the input that separates a wrong majority from a correct minority. Generated programs may crash, have side effects, need unavailable dependencies, or be unsafe to execute; library-mode fuzzing also depends on a valid driver. The approach exchanges LLM token cost for execution and fuzzing cost, so it is less suitable when sandboxed execution is expensive, prohibited, or cannot faithfully model the production environment.
当许多候选复现同一规格错误时，行为共识可能错误；模糊测试也可能遗漏能区分错误多数和正确少数的输入。生成程序可能崩溃、有副作用、依赖不可用环境，或不宜执行；库模式模糊测试还依赖有效驱动器。该方法把大语言模型词元成本换成执行和模糊测试成本，因此在沙箱执行昂贵、被禁止或无法忠实模拟生产环境时不太适用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use DiffCodeGen for self-contained code tasks where it is safe to run candidates but no tests are available. Isolate candidates in a resource-limited sandbox, log generated inputs and disagreements, and fall back to a human or formal checker when the largest behavior cluster is weak or suspiciously uniform. Treat fuzz time as part of the test-time budget: increase candidate diversity and fuzz coverage only while their pass@1 gain justifies the added wall-clock cost.
在候选可被安全运行、但没有测试可用的自包含代码任务中可使用 DiffCodeGen。应把候选隔离在资源受限的沙箱中，记录生成输入与分歧；当最大行为簇很弱或可疑地一致时，回退到人工或形式检查器。应把模糊测试时间计入测试时预算：只有候选多样性和覆盖率带来的 pass@1 收益值得额外墙钟成本时，才继续增加它们。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the work as a selection method under a missing-oracle assumption, not as a replacement for real tests. Its most useful comparison is against a method that receives the same candidate set but pays another model call to rank it. The three diversity mechanisms matter because differential analysis is informative only when candidates differ; inspect the paper's method-specific ablations before choosing sampling, beam search, or prompt perturbation for a target language and sandbox.
应把此工作理解为缺失预言机假设下的选择方法，而非真实测试的替代品。最有价值的比较是与获得相同候选集、却为排序支付另一次模型调用的方法相比。三种多样化机制很重要，因为只有候选存在差异时差分分析才有信息量；为目标语言和沙箱选择采样、束搜索或提示扰动前，应检查论文中按方法划分的消融实验。
